description: Deterministic CLI drawing recipe for Character Studio layers and packed RGB masks.

supersampling.reason: art may be antialiased for prerendered readability while semantic RGB channels remain exact

rules: Do not draw into the Blender underlay.
Do not change the canonical ground anchor.
Mask recipes contain semantic channel data only; no lighting, AO, outline or dithering.
Mask recipes must use supersample=1 so R/G/B semantic channels are never mixed by resampling.
All authoring coordinates use top-left pixel origin at 48x64 even when art is internally supersampled.
